verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly has a dedicated first-party docs page for scheduled flag changes, stating that you can 'define and schedule changes to your flag's targeting rules for future points in time' [35, 65]. Its targeting docs add time-bounded expiration dates for flag targeting [48]. Together these directly cover scheduling flag changes for a specific future time. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of scheduling release workflows (e.g. starting a progressive rollout at a set time) beyond targeting-rule changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the scheduling feature.
